catalog.description: Scans command literals returned for selected active ECS and classic Batch definition revisions with both offline detectors. Image defaults, external files and runtime overrides are not inspected.
catalog.fail_when: A supported secret is detected in identity-bound selected source, including when other inspection is incomplete.
evaluated: Exact selected native resource identity and captured content
Both offline detectors and selected-source completeness
catalog.not_applicable_when: No source is selected; denied, missing, unsupported and incomplete selected evidence remains undetermined.
catalog.pass_when: All selected supported source fields and both detectors complete without a supported secret detection.

PASS.meaning: All selected supported source fields and both detectors complete without a supported secret detection.

FAIL.meaning: A supported secret is detected in identity-bound selected source, including when other inspection is incomplete.

UNKNOWN.meaning: No source is selected; denied, missing, unsupported and incomplete selected evidence remains undetermined.

evidence.observed: Selected ECS/classic Batch command evidence was unavailable, incomplete or unbound; images, environment files and EKS Batch are outside this check.

limits: Explicit named content opt-in only; default metadata collection and IAM grants unchanged
No credential validity or executed workload bytes claim

root_owned_remaining: Root final concise native/merged renderer acceptance
No live cloud, effective deployed IAM or deployment claim
source_epoch: Separate native thematic addition; no new upstream source row or semantic equivalence inferred
